notes:
Summary: Enterprise evaluation focused on Dedicated capacity sizing. Customer runs real-time support chat + reranking for search and wants hard throughput guarantees for peak shopping events. Key metrics from traces: baseline steady QPS ~60 requests/sec (support chat avg), median tokens/request ~140, mean tokens/request ~180, estimated sustained tokens/sec ~10.8k (steady), peaks observed up to 250 QPS during hour-long bursts (token/sec peak ~45k).

Latency SLOs: target p95 <120ms for short chat responses (<256 tokens), p99 <250ms; for reranker workflows target p95 <200ms. Cost sensitivity: mid-high — willing to reserve capacity for predictable billing but need unit economics < $0.006/token on steady workloads.

Workshop outcomes desired: 1) baseline QPS / token/sec validation with Redwood loadgen against sample traces; 2) recommended reserved GPU count and instance types for steady vs peak (initial hypothesis: 4x H100 for steady + 2x burst H100, or 8x A10G spread across two AZs for cost-sensitive option); 3) autoscaling and burst policy recommendations (warm pool, fast routing to fallback models) to meet p99 SLOs; 4) SLA wording draft (uptime, latency SLO credits, scheduled maintenance windows).

Technical constraints / notes: customer must keep inference data in their VPC. KMS required for key wrapping. On-prem option evaluated for compliance-bound subset of customers. Need network peering and 10Gbps limits examined — current VPC peering requests pending.

Open questions the workshop should resolve: - exact token/sec to reserve for 99th percentile traffic - whether prefix caching can cover 40-60% of repeated context in chat flows - acceptable fallback model latency/cost tradeoffs for graceful degradation - verification plan for SLA latency measurements (tracing hooks / synthetic traffic).

Quotes/rep language: "We can tolerate a small percentage of degraded responses during seasonal peaks, but we need explicit routing and fallback guarantees." — Head of ML Infra.

Next immediate actions: agree workshop date (target week of 2026-03-22), customer to share sanitized full-day traces, Redwood SE to prepare loadgen harness and two cost/performance blueprint options (H100 reserved plan, A10G cost-optimized plan).
